title: Eagles Technology
category: Brand identity • Brand guidelines • Social media design
description: A visual identity exploration for Eagles Technology, covering an eagle-and-barcode mark, colour and type rules, packaging applications and product-focused social layouts.
challenge: Bring technology, product identification and protective packaging into one recognizable identity.
solution: The guideline explores an eagle, barcode and technology motif in purple and orange. Supporting campaign designs use a product-led layout system.
results: Selected work from a version 0.1 guideline and campaign files, presented as a design study rather than a claim of a final rollout.
